answer: Every defence that trusts the applicant fails the same way, so this one trusts the paper trail. Winery appellation registration with regional council attestation builds the trail as registration ties an identity to a vineyard inspected yearly by a regional council,. The vault is reuse: the evidence already exists, created for taxes, licences, and work, years before anyone imagined this gate. A forger must recreate all of it, and the anchor in each piece is a clerk or registrar holding an independent copy. The marble is the comparison.
